ticket.subject: Cancel my plan
ticket.message: I want to cancel my plan but I'm not sure which one I'm on.

retrieved_chunks.text:
## Plan Changes
- Customers may switch plans at any time from the billing settings page.
- Plan changes take effect at the next billing cycle.

## Escalation Guidance
Escalate when:
- the customer disputes a renewal charge,
- the account shows a failed payment but the customer disputes the charge,
- or the customer requests a special exception outside standard billing policy.

# Subscription Policy

## Billing and Renewal
- Monthly and annual subscriptions renew automatically unless the customer cancels before the renewal date.
- Cancellation requests are effective at the end of the current billing period unless otherwise stated by the account settings.
- Customers may cancel their subscription at any time, but no refund is guaranteed for the current billing period.

## Escalation Guidance
Escalate when:
- the refund request is outside the 7-day window,
- the customer submits a repeat refund request,
- or the policy cannot be verified from the available information.

Draft Reply:

Dear Customer,

To cancel your plan, you can switch to a different plan or cancel your current subscription from the billing settings page [source: subscription_policy.md]. If you're unsure which plan you're currently on, you can check your account settings or billing history to confirm.

Please note that cancellation requests are effective at the end of the current billing period, unless otherwise stated by your account settings [source: subscription_policy.md]. Additionally, no refund is guaranteed for the current billing period [source: subscription_policy.md].

If you need assistance with locating your current plan or have questions about the cancellation process, I'd be happy to help. However, if you have any disputes or concerns about your billing or would like to request a special exception, I may need to escalate your issue [source: subscription_policy.md, source: refund_policy.md].

Best regards,
[Your Name]
